notes.glasses: Glasses should be avoided if possible; no glare, reflections, or tinted lenses.
notes.smile: Neutral expression, mouth closed, looking straight into lens.
notes.ears: Ears and hairline should be unobstructed unless wearing traditional religious head covering.
notes.shadows: Even studio lighting without backdrop shadow.
notes.babyRules: Babies must be photographed against clean white background without toys or visible parent hands.
